prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please note that our client is now represented and any future inquiries should be routed to us.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured for this loss, along with confirmation of any other coverage that may apply, including umbrella or excess policies. Please provide this information in writing within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dashcam data, vehicle inspection and repair records, adjuster notes, and any communications with your insured or third parties. Routine destruction or alteration of any such material should be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.
